title: End-Devouring Rays
exact_target: Can any prescribed disjoint infinite family of rays in a countable end be replaced, retaining exactly its starting vertices, by disjoint rays meeting every ray in that end?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3306 (OPG-735). CC BY 4.0.
